segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I pulled up the order form we discussed. It has 42 seats at $68 per seat per month, annual term starting September 1, and the implementation package at $4,200 one-time.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I had. The only thing I want to confirm is the 42 seats includes the five read-only users from finance, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Thirty-seven standard users and five read-only. I noted that in the CRM and it is on page two of the quote as well.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. For billing, can you make sure the invoice goes to ap@northlineparts.com and includes our PO number? It should be PO-18477.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I can add PO-18477 before it goes to the billing tool. The invoice would be for $38,472 for the subscription plus the $4,200 services fee, so $42,672 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. On timing, we want to start onboarding the week of August 19, but we don't want the subscription clock to start until September 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that's fine. We can schedule kickoff for August 20 and keep September 1 as the contract start date. The services team has availability that Tuesday or Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let's hold August 20 at 10 Central. Also, procurement asked whether the renewal is automatic or if we get notice first.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It is annual auto-renewal, but the agreement has a 60-day notice window. You'll also get a reminder from us 90 days before renewal. If you want, I can highlight that section when I send it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Please do. Send it over today and I can route for signature. Assuming legal doesn't have edits, we should have it back by Friday.
